name: STEM Research Experience (CU Boulder Science Discovery)
org: University of Colorado Boulder, Science Discovery
what_you_do: Spend about seven weeks in a real CU Boulder or CU Anschutz research group with a mentor. Weekly research seminar, then a poster talk at the end. You earn a micro-credential.
who_can_apply: High school students who are 16 by June 2, 2027, with no exceptions. It is a commuter program with no housing.
pay_detail: The page does not post the cost yet. Limited scholarships for students with financial need; say so on the application.
duration: June 2 to July 30, 2027; 15 to 20 hours a week
deadline_text: Application opens mid-December 2026. Deadline March 16, 2027 at 11:59 PM MT. Notified by March 23, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online. Admission is competitive. Payment is due when you accept. Contact Steven Denham (email link on the page).
notes: No refunds after you enroll. Students match with CU Boulder mentors in May and at orientation on June 2, 2027. Poster session July 30, 2027.
